alert_summary: A PowerShell instance was launched from a node.js process with an encoded command that decodes to a Git diff operation—an unusual pattern that may indicate malicious activity hidden by obfuscation.

investigation_timeline.output_summary: regex: 12 candidates, 3 validated; command decode: 1 segment(s) decoded, 0 discarded; LLM: 2 candidates, 1 validated
draft-A: 8 action(s) selected; draft-B: experimental triage=uncertain

risk_assessment.rationale: The event shows PowerShell running with an encoded payload, a classic technique for concealing malware (T1027).  The correlation engine linked this single execution to 29 other events consistent with lateral‑movement tactics, and the domains involved are all unknown, raising suspicion of credential theft or covert exfiltration.  Because we lack visibility into the actual node module or the full payload, confidence remains moderate; however, the combination of obfuscation, lateral‑movement linkage, and untrusted domains warrants a high‑severity assessment.

recommended_actions: Review the parent-child process execution tree for the affected host
recommended_actions_freeform_experimenta: Immediately isolate the host from the network to prevent potential lateral movement.
Collect and preserve all relevant logs (Sysmon, Windows Event Log, PowerShell transcript) for forensic analysis.
Run a full memory dump of the affected machine and perform an in‑depth malware scan with up-to-date signatures.
Investigate the node.js package @anthropic-ai/claude-code to determine if it is legitimate or has been tampered with; check its integrity hash against the official repository.

Decode any additional PowerShell payloads that may have been executed by the same process chain and analyze them for known malicious patterns (e.g., base64‑encoded obfuscation, use of Invoke-Expression).

Cross‑reference the involved domains (dev-twong02.victimcorp.com, tommy.wong, cli.js, victimcorp.com) against threat intelligence feeds to see if they have been previously associated with malicious activity.
If the encoded command is confirmed malicious, block outbound traffic to those domains and any other suspicious IPs identified during analysis.
Document all findings in a detailed incident report and update internal playbooks to include detection rules for PowerShell executions originating from node.js processes.
triage_rationale_experimental: The presence of an encoded PowerShell command launched by a node.js process is suspicious, but without the actual decoded payload or evidence of malicious intent, we cannot definitively label it as a true positive.
